skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional numerators when the fractions have a common denominator, including after conversion or regrouping, while keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Separate mixed or whole-number parts
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers, whole numbers, or pure fractions by aligned whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the result
skills.definition: Put the final answer in standard lowest-term form by reducing fractions and omitting zero whole or zero fractional parts.
